name: committed-function-examples
goal: Show versioned human-readable usage examples from committed documents, with test evidence separate

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Reproduced function Tests showing verification gaps without usage examples; feature spec records committed-doc behavior.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend the standardized case-view viewport matrix and manifest validator; existing fixtures cover recorded service results only.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test commit 756510da fails the Examples viewport matrix; recorded proof bb65b5c34f9d0c21dd8e2114d83454ad86641822990f28679143b2ab6551196e.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix a776a015 adds Git-bound Markdown examples, shared input/output cards, legacy URLs and lazy verification disclosures.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged command and frozen inputs pass at a776a015. Proof 0851582f19e77853c42e3b1313eb33b993d27e946b50906b1ec33434c63fb2fd.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
